title: LCT Trading: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Shadow-Foam Tool Case. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Shadow-Foam Tool Case
options.lineage: two-layer kaizen foam in socket sets and shop shadow boards
options.thesis: The catalog is an open tool case: every SKU sits in its own cut pocket, and what you take shows as red.
materials: hex nut geometry from the logo
options.viewport: Search/SKU bar as the case lid rail; below, a tight grid of foam pockets per product, each with a stamped steel plate (SKU, price) and qty + Add right on it; cart is the tray docked at the side.
options.risk: Dark foam ground can feel heavy on bright outdoor phones; stamped plates must stay crisp, not skeuomorphic kitsch.

raised.raise: SKU list view set at one type size: rank carried by weight, case and reversal only, so contractors scan rows like a price sheet.
Absence is designed: an out-of-stock pocket is an empty cut showing red foam, drawn as deliberately as a full one.
Focus discipline: the pocket under focus lifts and reveals qty controls; neighbours stay quiet.

options.label: Parts-Bin Wall
options.lineage: labelled drawer walls of Banawe and Binondo hardware counters
options.thesis: Every product is a bin drawer with a paper label card slid into its steel frame.
options.viewport: A wall of drawer fronts by brand, label cards carrying SKU and price, qty stepper in the drawer pull.
options.risk: Also the direction most hardware-shop concepts land on; light ground softens the logo's black.

options.label: Price Totem
options.thesis: Prices lit as segment digits on a black totem.
options.viewport: Brand totems with prices in lit segments.
options.case: Fuses weakly: segment digits slow price reading and do not carry SKU names.
options.kept: Absence drawn as deliberately as light: designed out-of-stock state.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: One type size, rank by weight and reversal.
options.case: Fuses poorly: raked panes hurt fast SKU scanning on phones.
options.risk: Raked containers fight a dense catalog.
options.kept: Single-size dense rows for the SKU list view.

options.label: Title-Card Wall
options.thesis: Brand rows scrolling sideways, focused tile expands.
options.viewport: Row per brand of product tiles.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hides price/SKU until focus; horizontal rails slow ordering.
options.kept: Focused-item discipline: only the pocket in focus reveals controls.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.viewport: Giant glyph with a grid below.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nothing to do with buying tools.
options.kept: Scale contrast: huge brand wordmark vs tiny stamped labels.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.case: Fuses poorly: dreamlike, no link to hardware buyers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: White hardware e-commerce grid like khmtools: brand strip, product cards, red buttons.
canonCard.viewport: Header with search, brand logo strip, product card grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
